skill.name: readme
skill.body:
# Agent Skills Documentation

This directory contains the source code for the Agent Skills documentation site, which is built using [Mintlify](https://mintlify.com).

## Development

Install the [Mintlify CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mint) to preview your documentation changes locally. To install, use the following command:

```
npm i -g mint
```

Run the following command at the root of your documentation, where your `docs.json` is located:

```
mint dev
```

View your local preview at `http://localhost:3000`.

## Publishing changes

Changes are deployed to production automatically after pushing to the default branch.

## Need help?

### Troubleshooting

- If your dev environment isn't running: Run `mint update` to ensure you have the most recent version of the CLI.
- If a page loads as a 404: Make sure you are running in a folder with a valid `docs.json`.

### Resources
- [Mintlify documentation](https://mintlify.com/docs)

generated_query: I'm documenting a new API and want to use Mintlify for the docs site. I've created the `docs.json` config and the markdown files, but I'm stuck on the local preview. Could you walk me through installing the Mintlify CLI, starting the dev server, and checking the preview at `http://localhost:3000`? Also, when I tried to view a specific page, I got a 404 error—what could cause that, and how do I fix it? Lastly, I need to know how changes get published once I push to the main branch.

edit_instructions.target_text:
Run the following command at the root of your documentation, where your `docs.json` is located:

```
mint dev
```
edit_instructions.rationale: Deleting the command to start the dev server prevents users from launching the local preview, which is the core request.
Removing the preview URL leaves users without knowing where to check their local site, making the skill unhelpful for that step.
